description_for_human: The firm's KLERQ knowledge base: matters, work highlights, specialists, clients and presentations
description_for_model: KLERQ is the firm's knowledge base of matters, clients, contacts, specialists, work highlights, submissions and presentations (pitches). Use it to load the content for a pitch, to create the presentation record and to export it to PowerPoint. Record ids in results are handles for follow-up calls only; present every record to the user by name or title, never by id. Prefer the find_* and *_overview tools for questions; use *_get for one record and create/update only for changes the user asked for. To build a new presentation, call presentation_brief first, load the content with the read tools, then presentation_form with that content as data; both render an inline form where the client supports it.

functions.name: find_clients
functions.description: Search clients (companies) by name, type, active or archived, or by relational filters such as pitched but not submitted since a date.

functions.name: find_presentations
functions.description: Search presentations (pitches) by status, language, date windows, client name or specialist name.

functions.name: find_specialists
functions.description: Search the firm's specialists by name, role, office, active or archived, or by recent usage in submissions and presentations.

functions.name: find_matters
functions.description: Search matters by status, date windows, client name or responsible user.

functions.name: specialists_get
functions.description: Get one specialist with role, practices, industries and bio versions.

functions.name: matter_overview
functions.description: Get a matter together with all its work highlights in one call.

functions.name: presentations_get
functions.description: Get one presentation with its chapters and their content.

functions.name: presentations_create
functions.description: Create a presentation with its chapters. Only after the user approved the overview.

confirmation.title: Create presentation in KLERQ
confirmation.body: Create this presentation with the approved chapters?

functions.name: presentations_update
functions.description: Update an existing presentation or its chapters.

confirmation.title: Update presentation in KLERQ
confirmation.body: Apply these changes to the presentation?

functions.name: export_presentation
functions.description: Render a presentation to PowerPoint or Word through one of the firm's export templates and return a download link valid for 15 minutes. Call without template to list the templates.

functions.name: find_work_highlights
functions.description: Search a matter's work highlights by status, specialist or confidentiality.

functions.name: work_highlights_get
functions.description: Get one work highlight of a matter.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Semantic search across the whole workspace: matters, clients, contacts, presentations, submissions, work highlights.

functions.name: find_experience
functions.description: Find relevant firm experience and precedents (matters and work highlights) by a text query or similar to a reference matter.

functions.name: presentation_brief
functions.description: Step 1 of building a new presentation. Shows the brief box inline; call it first, before loading any KLERQ data. The brief comes back as a chat message starting with "[Presentation form] Brief".

functions.name: presentation_form
functions.description: Step 2 of building a new presentation. Renders the chapter-by-chapter form inline, prefilled from the brief; pass the form data (names only, never ids) as data. The approved choices come back as a chat message starting with "[Presentation form] Approve".
